usageNotes: Use this to permanently remove a Ceph MDS (Metadata Server) daemon from a specific node — typically after migrating the workload to another MDS or when decommissioning a node from the CephFS cluster. The target node must be online and reachable; the operation requires `Sys.Modify` at the root level. The return value is a task UPID, so poll the task status to confirm the daemon has been fully stopped and removed before proceeding with node changes.

examples.summary: Remove the MDS daemon named 'mds0' from node 'pve-ceph1'

destructiveReason: Permanently destroys the specified Ceph MDS daemon on the node, removing it from the CephFS metadata service pool; if it is the only active or standby MDS, CephFS will become unavailable until another MDS is deployed.
tips: Verify at least one other active or standby MDS exists before destroying this one to avoid CephFS downtime.
MDS name must match the pattern `[a-zA-Z0-9]([a-zA-Z0-9-]*[a-zA-Z0-9])?` — no leading/trailing hyphens.
Use `get_nodes_node_ceph_mds` to list current MDS daemons and their states before proceeding.
Poll the returned UPID via the tasks API to confirm destruction completes before making further cluster changes.
